item: Row 458: server values in the erase and import reports are inserted as written, and a list field that is not an array reads as empty
summary: Five marker swaps in app-backup.js (the shaped folders, the Hugging Face token folders, the two free-space overwrite folders, the import's safety copy name) passed a template holding a server path to String.replace as a string, which reads $& and $' as patterns, so a path holding one rewrote the sentence around it. They now use the function form, as the progress prefix already did. keys_left_names, left_untouched and left_common_names are read through one _list helper that keeps an array and turns anything else into an empty list, so a string or object from the server no longer makes .join throw and lose the whole erase report. No string, no locale or server change.
